description.text: It stands at a junction on Edden Way, hemmed in by taller tenements. Gas lamps light it, and a picture of Breeze hangs behind the bar.

items.text: Sent ahead to a meeting here, Wayne found the drinkers oddly gloomy and, with the barkeeper's help, lifted their spirits by mixing each of them a cocktail. When Wax and Marasi Colms arrived, MeLaan explained Paalm's skills and motives while Marasi took notes. Wayne had already settled the tab.
